name: The Madrid EDITION
positioning: Modern urban hotel on a quiet historic square near Puerta de Sol in central Madrid, with decor detailing by Ian Schrager and a rooftop pool and terrace
best_for: Travelers who want a central Madrid base within walking distance of the Golden Triangle of Art
Guests who enjoy a rooftop terrace, cocktail bars and a Peruvian restaurant under one roof
Families and groups who need interconnected rooms

facts.text: The hotel sits on a tranquil square surrounded by historic buildings, near Puerta de Sol in the heart of Madrid.
The hotel is within walking distance of the Golden Triangle of Art, three of Madrid's most important art museums.
From Sol station, the hotel's Celenque Square is about a 300 m walk down Arenal Street.
The rooms have modern decor with detailing by Ian Schrager.
Rooms include floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Royal Palace, the Almudena cathedral and Gran Via.
Interconnected rooms are offered for families and groups of up to 8 guests.
Oroya serves family-style sharing plates such as ceviches, Peruvian-style fried calamari and lucuma desserts.
Oroya is set in a greenhouse-like room framed by a blackened steel cage with climbing plants and coloured glass panels.
Punch Room is an intimate cocktail bar that revives the ritual of punch, the precursor to the modern cocktail.
The Spa has a Finnish dry sauna, steam room and relaxation lounge, and is open to day guests as well as hotel guests.
The hotel has a 24-hour fitness centre, which guests can use at no charge.

highlights.text: Oroya is the hotel's Peruvian restaurant, led by chef Diego Muñoz, on the 4th floor.
The Roof, Oroya's terrace, has a fireplace and a vine-covered pergola.
The rooftop infinity pool on the fourth floor has views of the Teatro Real, the Royal Palace, the dome of the Almudena Cathedral and Casa de Campo.
The Lobby Bar has a pool table sculpted by designer Emmanuel Levet Stenne from a single slab of white Bianco Neve matt marble.
Oroya won at the Top Cocktail Bars Awards in 2024, for the third consecutive year.

considerations.text: The pool will be seasonally closed after October 18, 2026.
The Roof terrace is open to hotel residents and the local community alike.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing and a modern minimalist style that may not suit traditional preferences.
